README: The Supabase preset: on for a product that lists "supabase" in
`integrations`, or, while it lists nothing, has a supabase/ folder.
supabase-db-push   `supabase db push` only into an environment the product
does not protect, with --db-url or --remote <url> only
into a local database, never with --remote <ref|branch>;
and `db reset` that name a target follow the same rules.
Which environment the tree is on, and which are
protected, the product says once, under `environments` in
supabase-workdir   no --workdir past the feature's own local stack.
supabase-shared    a question before a schema change on a shared project.
supabase-own-reset a plain `db reset` of the feature's own stack goes through
